fields.description: The opaque docname series. A volunteer is never keyed by an email, a name or a badge number. Mutable data does not go in a primary key.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: The person, as onerc_core's identity spine. This is the only identity this record holds: no name, email or phone is stored here, and there is no fetch_from either, because a fetched value is a stored copy wearing a different hat. Read those through vmmsx/volunteer/services/identity.py, which reads Red Profile at the moment of asking.
fields.label: Red Profile

fields.description: What this person is to the society, and the truth of it: the affiliation row on their Red Profile is a summary written from here, never the other way round. Prospective and Active are derived from the volunteer's approved applications; Suspended and Exited are explicit acts of the society that a derivation must never quietly undo. Written by vmmsx/volunteer/services/volunteer.py, not by hand.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: When this person first became an active volunteer. Set once, at the first acceptance, and never moved by a later application.
fields.label: Joined On

fields.description: ACC-02. The branch this volunteer serves with: where they belong in the organisational tree, the field core's geo scoping reads to decide who may see them, and the node a Branch Transfer moves. A Link, never free text, and mandatory at creation, because an unplaced volunteer is invisible to geo scoping: core's list filter is an IN and that excludes NULL. Which level it may sit at is society configuration (ACC-03, vmms_volunteer_anchor_level), never a constant. Seeded at acceptance from the application's own anchor, which is the Serving Branch the applicant chose. Where the volunteer LIVES is a different question and is not stored here at all: Home Area belongs to the person rather than to their volunteering, so it lives once on their Red Profile and the coordinator view reads it from there. The fieldname is historical and predates the two questions being told apart; the label is what it holds.
fields.label: Serving Branch

fields.description: When the society recorded that this person stopped volunteering. Set alongside the Exited status; empty for everybody else.
fields.label: Exited On

fields.description: Which country this volunteer is a citizen of. Deliberately decoupled from where they live: a citizen of this society's own country living abroad, and a foreign national living and volunteering locally, both answer this question without residency deciding it. Seeded from the application at acceptance; a naturalisation or a correction is edited here, and the application keeps what was declared on the day.
fields.label: Citizenship

fields.description: Whether this volunteer lives inside the society's own geo tree or outside it. Local means Home Area beside it is the answer to where they live; Abroad means Country of Residence and Address Abroad are, and Home Area then holds the branch they are attached to rather than a place they live. Seeded from the application at acceptance and editable here, because somebody who moves abroad is still the same volunteer.
fields.label: Residency

fields.description: Which country this volunteer lives in when they live outside the society's own tree. Cleared whenever residency is Local, so the record never carries a stale answer to a question it is not asking.
fields.label: Country of Residence

fields.description: Where this volunteer lives when they live outside the society's own tree, as free text, because an address abroad has no Geo Node to point at. Cleared whenever residency is Local.
fields.label: Address Abroad

fields.description: What this volunteer can do now, as a multi-select of the society's own VMMS Skill vocabulary. Seeded from the application at acceptance and editable here from then on: this is current truth, not the claim made on the day of applying, and the two are meant to diverge as somebody learns. The application keeps its own copy untouched as history. Structured rather than free text so a coordinator can filter the register by it; that filter runs on top of geo scoping, never instead of it.
fields.label: Skills

fields.description: Languages this volunteer speaks now, as a multi-select of Frappe's own Language doctype, reused rather than reinvented. Seeded from the application at acceptance and editable here from then on. Read by a coordinator choosing who to send somewhere; never read by code.
fields.label: Languages Spoken

fields.description: When this volunteer can currently serve, as a multi-select of the society's own VMMS Availability Slot vocabulary. Seeded from the application at acceptance and editable here from then on, because availability is the fact about a volunteer most likely to have changed since they applied. Filterable alongside skills, on top of geo scoping.
fields.label: Availability

fields.description: The Frappe HR Employee record for this person, when the society provisions one. A thin, one-directional seam: vmmsx points at HR and HR knows nothing of vmmsx. Identity never moves here: Red Profile stays the spine, and no field on Employee is ever read as this person's name, email or phone. Provisioning is off unless the society switches vmms_volunteer_provision_employee on. Empty is the ordinary state, and nothing in this module needs it to be set.
fields.label: Employee

fields.description: Anything the volunteering office needs to record about this person that is not a field.
fields.label: Notes

fields.description: The opaque handle a printed card is verified by. Minted the first time a card is issued and never rotated: a card already in somebody's pocket has this printed on it.
fields.label: Card Token
